name: infinite-grid
title: Infinite Grid
description: A full-screen grid of image cards that drifts continuously and wraps around as it goes. A slight barrel distortion bends the edges, and each card holds a title, badge, date and tags.
use: A hero or showcase wants a dense wall of images that keeps moving without user input.
avoid: It runs a WebGL loop every frame and needs a sized parent, and the card text is tiny.
a11y: The WebGL grid exposes no text to assistive tech, has no keyboard path and ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark stage is tiled with small photo cards, each showing a landscape picture, a title, a badge, a date and a row of tags. The grid curves and tilts toward the edges, packed edge to edge with no background gaps.
behaves: The whole grid glides on its own in an endless loop, pulling new cards in from one side. Cards can be clicked, and the pack never settles while the scene is running.
customise: cardData (title, badge, description, tags, date, image) and options (grid size, gap, tile size, camera, post-processing) plus callbacks are props; the scroll logic lives in helper files.
weight: heavy: A WebGL scene with post-processing redrawn every frame.
